```{r}
# Because we're going to be working with the ADT data extensively, we're going to switch the
# default assay to the 'CITE' assay.  This will cause all functions to use ADT data by default,
# rather than requiring us to specify it each time
DefaultAssay(dcSubReg) <- "ADT"
dcSubReg <- RunPCA(dcSubReg, features = rownames(dcSubReg), reduction.name = "pca_adt", reduction.key = "pca_adt_", verbose = FALSE)
DimPlot(dcSubReg, reduction = "pca_adt")
```
```{r}
# Since we only have 10 markers, instead of doing PCA, we'll just use a standard euclidean
# distance matrix here.  Also, this provides a good opportunity to demonstrate how to do
# visualization and clustering using a custom distance matrix in Seurat
adt.data <- GetAssayData(dcSubReg, slot = "data")
adt.dist <- dist(t(adt.data))

# Before we recluster the data on ADT levels, we'll stash the RNA cluster IDs for later
dcSubReg[["rnaClusterID"]] <- Idents(dcSubReg)

# Now, we rerun tSNE using our distance matrix defined only on ADT (protein) levels.
dcSubReg[["tsne_adt"]] <- RunTSNE(adt.dist, assay = "ADT", reduction.key = "adtTSNE_")
dcSubReg[["adt_snn"]] <- FindNeighbors(adt.dist)$snn
dcSubReg <- FindClusters(dcSubReg, resolution = 0.2, graph.name = "adt_snn")

# We can compare the RNA and protein clustering, and use this to annotate the protein clustering
# (we could also of course use FindMarkers)
clustering.table <- table(Idents(dcSubReg), dcSubReg$rnaClusterID)
clustering.table
```

```{r}
new.cluster.ids <- c("HSPC", "cDC", "preDC", "pDC")
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(dcSubReg)
dcSubReg <- RenameIdents(dcSubReg, new.cluster.ids)

tsne_rnaClusters <- DimPlot(dcSubReg, reduction = "tsne_adt", group.by = "rnaClusterID") + NoLegend()
tsne_rnaClusters <- tsne_rnaClusters + ggtitle("Clustering based on scRNA-seq") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
tsne_rnaClusters <- LabelClusters(plot = tsne_rnaClusters, id = "rnaClusterID", size = 4)

tsne_adtClusters <- DimPlot(dcSubReg, reduction = "tsne_adt", pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()
tsne_adtClusters <- tsne_adtClusters + ggtitle("Clustering based on ADT signal") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
tsne_adtClusters <- LabelClusters(plot = tsne_adtClusters, id = "ident", size = 4)

# Note: for this comparison, both the RNA and protein clustering are visualized on a tSNE
# generated using the ADT distance matrix.
wrap_plots(list(tsne_rnaClusters, tsne_adtClusters), ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
Adt.thresh = 0.8
RidgePlot(KO5, features = c("Adt.CD11b","Adt.B220"))
KO5s <- subset(KO5, subset = Adt.CD11b >= Adt.thresh & Adt.B220 >=Adt.thresh)
FeatureScatter(KO5s, feature1 = "Adt.CD11b",  feature2 = "Adt.B220")
WT5s <- subset(WT5, subset = Adt.CD11b >= Adt.thresh & Adt.B220 >=Adt.thresh)
FeatureScatter(WT5s, feature1 = "Adt.CD11b",  feature2 = "Adt.B220")
FeaturePlot(WT5s, reduction='umap', features = c("Adt.CD11c", "Adt.CD11b", "Adt.B220", "Adt.MHCII", "Adt.SiglecH"), min.cutoff = "q05", max.cutoff = "q50", ncol = 3)
FeaturePlot(KO5s, reduction='umap', features = c("Adt.CD11c", "Adt.CD11b", "Adt.B220", "Adt.MHCII", "Adt.SiglecH"), min.cutoff = "q05", max.cutoff = "q50", ncol = 3)
table(WT5s@meta.data$rnaClusterID)/table(WT5@meta.data$rnaClusterID)
table(KO5s@meta.data$rnaClusterID)/table(KO5@meta.data$rnaClusterID)


KO3s <- subset(KO3, subset = Adt.CD11b >= Adt.thresh & Adt.B220 >=Adt.thresh)

table(WT3s@meta.data$rnaClusterID)/table(WT3@meta.data$rnaClusterID)
```
